notes.title: Discover Pre-Alpha combat gameplay from our demo with 5 great content creators.
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers, 

We wanted to show our promise of a smoother combat system with our PAX demo but it was too rough to share with everyone so we reached out to a few outstanding Outward content creators to look it up and share their thoughts. 

So have a look and let us know what you think!

CohhCarnage with the participation of Guillaume Boucher-Vidal, Nine Dots Studio CEO and Creative Director.
[previewyoutube=Ay1gNV2h6DI;full][/previewyoutube]

Your support means a lot to our studio and allows us to create the games you like. 
Consider looking into our ongoing projects by clicking the links below.


 Follow Nine Dots Studios to get all the news first about our upcoming games.
 Wishlist Lost In Prayer - a turn-based tactical roguelike set in heaven and hell where you can become anything that kills you.
 Wishlist Witherbloom - a 1-4 players cooperative dungeon delving action RPG set in a forlorn world published by Nine Dots.



Thanks a lot,
Matthieu

notes.title: Exclusive Dev Livestream with CohhCarnage on 30/04 on Twitch.
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers, 

This upcoming Tuesday, April 30th, at 6PM CET / 12PM EST / 9 AM PST, join us on Twitch as we will be streaming our pre-Alpha demo with CohhCarnage!

Watch the stream directly here 

With the participation of Creative Director Guillaume Boucher-Vidal and content creator CohhCarnage, you will discover the new combat system of Outward 2 and how we improved from the original. 

You can hit the “Set a Reminder” button on the right of this post to be notified when we’re live.
